XZRaycastMemoryMap(Vector3, Vector3, float, out NavmeshMemoryMapperCastHit, bool, bool)

Performs a raycast through the memory-mapped navigation mesh, sampling along a specified direction and distance, and returns information about the encountered tiles and obstacles.
public void XZRaycastMemoryMap(Vector3 origin, Vector3 dir, float maxDistance, out PathOSNavUtility.NavmeshMemoryMapper.NavmeshMemoryMapperCastHit hit, bool fillSeen = false, bool pointSample = false)

Parameters

origin Vector3
The starting point of the ray in world coordinates.
dir Vector3
The normalized direction vector along which to cast the ray.
maxDistance float
The maximum distance, in world units, to cast the ray from the origin.
hit PathOSNavUtility.NavmeshMemoryMapper.NavmeshMemoryMapperCastHit
When this method returns, contains information about the raycast, including the number of unexplored tiles, the total distance traversed, and the proportion of unexplored tiles encountered.
fillSeen bool
If set to true, marks all sampled tiles along the ray as seen. The default is false.
pointSample bool
If set to true, considers the raycast as a point sample. The default is false.

Remarks

The raycast samples the navigation mesh at regular intervals, stopping when it reaches the edge of the grid, encounters more than one obstacle tile, or exceeds the specified maximum distance. This method can be used to determine visibility or path obstruction in grid-based navigation systems.
